entries.clue: Grey fluff that settles on a shelf between one Sunday and the next
Its clanking lid used to wake the whole street on collection morning
Red-wine mark that survives three trips through the machine
One of three screws astern, the middle one turned by a turbine, the outers by pistons
Shipyard city where Harland and Wolff built her and slid her into the water
Oak-panelled sweep under an iron and glass dome, the first-class showpiece
Two ___: side-by-side riding the Highway Code now says can be the safer way
To hinder; also the lidded basket dirty clothes go into
The M of her R.M.S.; five clerks drowned hauling sacks of it from the sorting room
Plates bolted to cycling shoes to lock into clipless pedals
Stack of gears locked onto the rear hub, swapped for a bigger one before the mountains
Small toothed wheel, or a lowly worker in a vast machine
Sprung clip that grips washing to the line; the proud get taken down one or two
